name: testflow
//engines: 22.12 is a hard floor, not a preference. firebase-admin/auth eagerly requires jwks-rsa, which does a top-level require('jose') — and jose@6 is pure ESM. require() of an ESM package only works on Node >=20.19 or >=22.12 (hence jwks-rsa's own engines: ^20.19.0 || ^22.12.0 || >= 23.0.0). On anything older it throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM the moment the auth module is loaded, and every authenticated route 500s. firebase-admin@14 also requires >=22 on its own. Written as a bare major, NOT a range: Vercel only ships whole majors (24.x/22.x/20.x) and this is the form its docs specify, so there is nothing for a host to resolve differently than intended. .nvmrc carries the same number for hosts that read that instead. GET /api/health reports the Node version it actually got, plus whether firebase-admin/auth loaded — check there before assuming this field was honoured.
